payment.title: Online payment
payment.none: No online payment was started for this order. Orders paid by bank transfer or in person are marked paid by hand.
payment.card.title: Payment of {amount}, started {at}
payment.card.unknownBody: The payment page may or may not exist at the provider. A new attempt is refused until the shop settles this one, and a payment may still arrive. Use Check status; do not mark the order paid by hand without checking.
payment.outcome.already_paid: The order was already paid with this payment
payment.outcome.order_not_payable: The order could no longer be paid (expired or cancelled)
payment.outcome.amount_mismatch: The amount did not match the order, so the order was not paid
payment.outcome.reference_conflict: The order was already paid another way
payment.attention.title: This payment needs your attention
payment.attention.closed: An earlier attention item was closed: {code}.
payment.attention.code.late_payment: Paid after the order could no longer be paid
payment.attention.code.amount_mismatch: Amount does not match the order
payment.attention.code.fact_not_bound: A provider notice did not match this payment
payment.attention.code.unknown_provider_: The provider sent a status the shop does not know
payment.attention.code.unexpected_provid: The provider reported an unexpected status
payment.attention.code.external_reversal: The money was returned outside the shop
payment.attention.code.refund_mismatch: A refund does not match the provider's records
payment.attention.code.reconcile_gave_up: The shop stopped checking this payment
payment.attention.help.late_payment: The customer paid after the order expired or was cancelled. The shop refunds such a payment automatically; check that the refund below is refunded, then close this item.
payment.attention.help.duplicate_payment: The order was already paid another way. The shop refunds the extra payment automatically; check that the refund below is refunded, then close this item.
payment.attention.help.amount_mismatch: The provider charged an amount that differs from the order total, so the order was not marked paid and nothing was refunded. Compare with the provider's records, then refund or mark the order paid by hand.
payment.attention.help.fact_not_bound: A notice about this payment did not match what the shop sent. Nothing was changed. Use Check status; if it keeps coming back, contact support.
payment.attention.help.unknown_provider_: The provider reported a status this version does not understand. Nothing was changed. Use Check status and look at the payment in the provider's cabinet.
payment.attention.help.unexpected_provid: The provider reported a status that does not fit this payment's state. Use Check status and compare with the provider's cabinet.
payment.attention.help.external_reversal: The provider reports the payment as reversed although the shop did not refund it (for example a refund made in the provider's cabinet). Compare with the provider's records.
payment.attention.help.refund_failed: The provider refused a refund. The amount is available to refund again. Check the failure code in the refunds table, fix the cause, then try again or return the money another way.
payment.attention.help.refund_mismatch: The provider's record of a refund differs from the shop's. Use Check status and compare with the provider's cabinet before refunding again.
payment.attention.help.reconcile_gave_up: The shop checked this payment for a long time and stopped. Use Check status once; if the status is still unclear, look at the payment in the provider's cabinet.
payment.attention.help.unknown: Check the payment in the provider's cabinet, then close this item.
payment.refunds.caption: Refunds of this payment
payment.refunds.waiting: A refund is waiting for the provider. A refund that is requested or whose result is unknown keeps its amount reserved and is never sent twice; the shop settles it from the provider's records. Use Check status to look again.
payment.journal.caption: Journal of this payment
payment.notice.refund.succeeded.title: Refund done
payment.notice.refund.succeeded: {amount} was refunded to the customer's card.
payment.notice.refund.processing.title: Refund being processed
payment.notice.refund.processing: The provider accepted the refund of {amount} and is processing it. It will show as refunded once the provider confirms; check again later.
payment.notice.refund.requested.title: Refund requested
payment.notice.refund.requested: The refund of {amount} is recorded but was not sent to the provider yet (the provider is busy). The shop sends it shortly, once. Check again in a minute.
payment.notice.refund.unknown.title: Refund requested, result unknown
payment.notice.refund.unknown: The refund of {amount} was requested, but the provider's answer was lost, so it is not known whether the money moved. The amount stays reserved and the shop will not send it again. Check again with Check status; do not refund this amount a second time.
payment.notice.refund.failed.title: Refund refused
payment.notice.refund.failed: The provider refused the refund of {amount}. Nothing was returned and the amount can be refunded again.
payment.notice.refund.replay: This exact request had been made before; nothing was sent again.
payment.notice.refundLost: No answer came, so it is not known whether the refund was requested. Nothing was sent again. The payment was read again: look at the refunds table. If there is no new refund, open Refund again: the form holds the same request, and sending it again cannot refund twice.
payment.notice.resyncLost: No answer came, so the status was not checked. The payment was read again; try Check status once more.
payment.notice.clearLost: No answer came, so it is not known whether the item was closed. The payment was read again; look at it before trying again.
payment.unavailable: The payment provider is not available right now. Nothing was changed; try again later.
payment.unavailableRetry: The payment provider is not available right now. Nothing was changed; try again in {seconds} seconds.
payment.refusal.refund_not_allowed: This payment cannot be refunded (it is not paid, or it is still being settled). Nothing was changed.
payment.refusal.refund_exceeds_remaining: That is more than can still be refunded on this payment. The payment was read again; use the remaining amount shown.
payment.refusal.partial_refund_not_suppo: This provider does not refund part of a payment. Refund the full remaining amount.
payment.refusal.payment_not_available: This payment's provider is not enabled in this shop, so it cannot be checked or refunded here. Use the provider's cabinet.
payment.refusal.payment_in_progress: An online payment of this order is in progress. Nothing was changed; wait until the payment provider confirms or declines it.
payment.refusal.payment_window_too_short: There is not enough time left on this order to start a new online payment.
payment.refusal.keyReused: This refund form was already used for a different amount or note. Close the dialog and open Refund again.
payment.fieldError.invalid_amount: Enter an amount of at least the smallest currency unit.
payment.fieldError.currency_mismatch: The amount is not in the payment's currency.
payment.refund.title: Refund order {number}
payment.refund.description: Return money to the customer's card. A partial amount is allowed. The order status does not change.
payment.refund.confirmDescription: Check the amount before you confirm. The money is sent back to the customer's card.
payment.refund.amountHint: Up to {max}, at most {decimals} decimals. The field starts at everything that is left; type less for a partial refund.
payment.refund.noteHint: Kept with the refund, for your team. Up to {max} characters.
payment.refund.confirmBody: You are about to refund {amount} ({currency}) to the customer's card.
payment.refund.retryHint: The last attempt got no answer. This is the same request: sending it again cannot refund twice. If you change the amount or the reason, it becomes a new request.
payment.refund.amountIssue.comma_separat: Use a dot as the decimal separator, not a comma.
payment.refund.amountIssue.inner_space: Remove the spaces inside the amount.
payment.refund.amountIssue.too_many_deci: This currency has at most {decimals} decimals.
payment.refund.amountIssue.exceeds_remai: At most {max} can still be refunded.
payment.refund.noteIssue.invalid_charact: The reason has characters that are not allowed.
payment.clear.title: Close this attention item?
payment.clear.body: The payment is no longer listed as needing attention. The code stays on the payment and the journal records who closed it.
payment.clear.note: Close it only after you have dealt with it. Closing changes nothing at the provider.
payment.list.intro: Payments that need an admin: paid too late, paid twice, a wrong amount, a refund that failed or whose result is unknown, or a payment the shop stopped checking. Open the order to check, refund or close the item.
payment.list.caption: Payments that need attention
payment.list.shown: {count} shown. That is all of them.
